root_cause_label: False premise that HTTP-proxying raw VNC port satisfies web interface requirement; knowledge gap about needing websockify/noVNC and UNIX monitor socket for programmatic keyboard input
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent configured a telnet QEMU monitor instead of the required UNIX socket for programmatic keyboard input, and attempted to HTTP-proxy raw VNC traffic through nginx without websockify/noVNC, resulting in a VM that runs but cannot pass the automated keyboard-input or functional web VNC tests.
t_err_evidence: Step 26 creates /app/start_win311.sh with '-monitor telnet:localhost:4444,server,nowait' instead of the required UNIX socket '-monitor unix:/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock,server,nowait'; simultaneously step 32 creates an nginx location block proxying /vnc/ directly to port 5901 via HTTP, which cannot work without a WebSocket bridge (websockify + noVNC).
t_commit_evidence: Step 51: QEMU successfully starts in daemonized mode with the telnet monitor configuration locked in. From this point the VM runs but the UNIX socket and websockify are never added; the agent proceeds to verification and final claim without fixing these issues.
t_surface_evidence: Step 60: curl http://localhost/ returns HTTP 502 (nginx trying to proxy to 127.0.0.1:8080, which is not running), revealing the web interface is broken. Later step 71 confirms /vnc/ returns 404 (no noVNC content), directly showing the web VNC interface failure.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed that an nginx location block proxying HTTP requests to port 5901 (raw VNC TCP) would constitute a functional web VNC interface, without knowing that a WebSocket bridge (websockify) and noVNC client are required. It also assumed a telnet monitor would satisfy 'programmatic keyboard input' without knowing the test harness expects a UNIX socket at /tmp/qemu-monitor.sock.
forewarning_evidence: Step 32 LLM analysis flags 'missing_websockify_wrong_protocol_proxy' as an error; step 37 flags 'wrong_protocol_proxy'; step 43 flags 'wrong_monitor_interface_missing_unix_socket'; step 46 shows a QEMU startup error (serial+daemonize conflict). These signals appear before t_commit=51 but the agent never corrects the fundamental monitor socket or websockify issues.
